applications.name: CadQuery
applications.version: Source commit 33361dc1b5b70bc83ce36f1b34a01ca85dfca80a; STEP fixture, assembly exporter, and CQGI execution source inspected; no CAD execution
E3: The STEP fixture exposes product names, solids and colors, and assembly export enables names/layers/colors. Geometry equivalence and the editable source's constraints, parameters and OCCT/runtime dependencies have not been reconstructed. Readable Python plus STEP entity counts do not establish the declared engineering-intent recovery.
E5: CQGI executes model text with real Python builtins and captures exceptions; the inspected path does not establish a sandbox. No effective execution authorization, dependency trust, output-overwrite visibility or correction after model side effects is established for the declared workflow.
longevity: E3 is not established for CadQuery's existing essential-record scope. The previous Longevity finding is replaced by Not assessed, not a verified failure or a positive placeholder.
transparency: The positive control observations above do not yet establish whole-scope E5. The methodology requires that minimum before a positive Transparency and Control finding; the previous positive finding is therefore withdrawn to Not assessed, not changed to Does not meet.
applications.remaining: Geometry equivalence, editable constraints in another CAD tool, complete offline rebuild, and execution/overwrite safeguards. E5 needs model/dependency execution authority, overwrite controls and correction boundaries; exception capture is not isolation.
applications.current_remaining: Geometry equivalence, editable constraints in another CAD tool, complete offline rebuild, and execution/overwrite safeguards. E5 needs model/dependency execution authority, overwrite controls and correction boundaries; exception capture is not isolation.
applications.next: Inspect source, pinned dependency records and STEP/native output with expected geometry/constraint manifests supplied by upstream or an assessor. Review execution/overwrite safeguards without running untrusted model code.
E2: STEP name/color/layer output does not establish migration of the essential parametric constraints and editable intent into an independent CAD workflow. The former E2 Pass is therefore unestablished, not a verified failure of every possible exit route.
sovereignty: A positive Sovereignty finding requires established E1, E2 and E4 in the declared scope. The existing access/exit/custody record for CadQuery does not establish all three minimums. The prior positive finding is withdrawn; recorded storage and portability strengths remain facts, not a verified failure.
